crossRefs.note: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.
All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.
All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and…
The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow…

people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

translations.web: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
translations.bsb: So Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.
translations.kjv: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
translations.asv: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: And he died.
